input.overview: Soccer and Super Soccer track up to ten Bonus units as plastic balls in the backglass. Send the ball through the spinner from the left flipper or toward the red collect hole from the right. The yellow mystery hole adds one, two, or three Bonus units and scores 500, 1,000, or 1,500. The red hole collects the indicated Bonus, which also pays when the ball drains.
input.simpleOverview: In Soccer and Super Soccer, use the spinner from the left flipper and the red Bonus-collect hole from the right. The yellow mystery hole adds one, two, or three backglass Bonus balls and scores 500, 1,000, or 1,500. The red hole collects the shown Bonus before the ball drains; the right side lane opens the outlane gate.
input.summary: Use the upper feeds and collect a nearly full Bonus at the red hole before advances are wasted. Take the yellow mystery hole when its feed is available, and nudge upper action toward the right side lane so the outlane gate is open.

quickInfo.name: Yellow mystery hole
quickInfo.summary: Add one, two, or three Bonus units and score 500, 1,000, or 1,500.

quickInfo.name: Checkered target
quickInfo.summary: Advance the yellow lights; every five advances adds one Bonus unit and 500 points.

quickInfo.name: Last-ball value
quickInfo.summary: Raise each Bonus unit to 2,000 or 3,000 according to the ball-count setting.

steps.text: Shoot the spinner from the left flipper or send the ball toward the upper holes from the right.
Collect the yellow mystery hole when available to add one, two, or three Bonus units.
Watch the plastic-ball count in the backglass as it approaches the ten-unit maximum.
Shoot the red hole to collect the indicated Bonus before additional advances are wasted.
Repeat the build-and-collect cycle, using the right side lane to open the outlane gate when upper action reaches it.
Add Bonus through the mystery hole, checkered target cycle, and upper-playfield action.
Reach or approach ten backglass balls.
Shoot the red hole to collect the Bonus before rebuilding it.

machineSetup: Confirm three- or five-ball play because the per-unit Bonus value changes by ball number, then confirm gate behavior, mystery-hole step range, Extra Ball or Special conversion, and tilt penalty.
Test both spinners, yellow mystery hole and step unit, red collect hole, checkered target and five-step yellow-light cycle, backglass ball rail, right side lane, outlane gate, and three pop bumpers.
